item.title: Coding Agent Debug Logs Guide 2026: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub MCP, and Playwright MCP
item.description: AI coding agents ship code faster than ever, but when they break, the debugging experience is nothing like a traditional stack trace. You don’t get a line number and a segfault — you get a silent hang, a garbled terminal, a 529 from the API, or an MCP server that just won’t connect. After spending the last year running Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub MCP Server, and Playwright MCP in production pipelines, I’ve collected the debug patterns that actually work. Here’s the field guide I wish I’d had.
